এই ই-বুকে বাছাই করা ৫০০টিরও বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ প্রশ্ন MCQ ফরম্যাটে দেওয়া হয়েছে, যাতে পরীক্ষার আগে অল্প সময়ের মধ্যে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয়গুলি একবার ঝালিয়ে নেওয়া যায়।

🎁 ই-বুকটি সম্পূর্ণ বিনামূল্যে দেওয়া হবে।

ဖရက်ဒီဆိုတာ အသက် ၂၈ နှစ်အထိရည်းစားတစ်ခါမှ မထားဖူးတဲ့ လူပျိုကြီးတစ်ယောက်ပေါ့သူ့ရဲ့ ရိုးရိုးအေးအေး တုံးတုံးအအ ပုံစံကြောင့်မိန်းကလေးတွေကလည်း သူ့ကိုမကြိုက်ကြဘူး 

သူက သွားဆရာဝန်တစ်ယောက်ဖြစ်ပြီး မိဘမရှိ၊ အဒေါ်နှစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ အုပ်ထိန်းမှုအောက်မှာပဲနေနေရတာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ် 

အချစ်ကိုရှာဖွေရင်း အထီးကျန်ဆန်လှတဲ့ သူ့ဘဝကို စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားမှုတွေ ရင်ဖိုမှုတွေ ပေးမယ့် မိန်းကလေးတစ်ယောက် ရောက်ရှိလို့လာခဲ့ပါတယ် 

အဲဒီမိန်းကလေးဟာအိမ်ထောင်သည် တစ်ယောက် ဖြစ်နေပေမယ့် သူ အဲဒီမိန်းကလေးကို ချစ်မိသွားခဲ့ပါတယ် လက်ထပ်ဖို့အထိပါ စဉ်းစားခဲ့ပြီးအဲဒီမိန်းကလေးကို ချဉ်းကပ်ပါတော့တယ်

တကယ်တော့ အဲဒီမိန်းကလေးဟာ သူ့ယောက်ျားရဲ့ အထက်စီးဆန်မှု မောင်ပိုင်စီးမှုနဲ့ နှိပ်စက်မှုတွေရဲ့ သားကောင်ဖြစ်နေခဲ့ရတဲ့သူ ဖြစ်ပါတယ် ဒီလိုနဲ့ ဖရက်ဒီနဲ့ သူနဲ့ ရှေ့ဆက်ဘယ်လိုဖြစ်မလဲဆိုတာ...

मराठी विषयाचा अभ्यास आणखी सोपा करण्यासाठी जॉईन करा: @marathi

Ghar pe ho? Jo ni hai , when you go home, don’t say anything.

Just sit somewhere and look at your parents for a while.

Really look at them.

You might notice things you were too busy to notice before.

Father saab looks a little more tired now.
Maa gets up a little more slowly.
There are medicines in the house that weren’t there a few years ago.

And suddenly you realise…

they are getting old while you are trying to build your life.

That’s the part nobody prepares us for bhai.

Because in our head, our parents somehow remain the same.

Papa will always be there.
Mummy will always be there.
There will always be another birthday, another diwali, holi, another attempt, another “agli baar.”

But time doesn’t work like that.

They won’t tell you they’re getting older.

They’ll still call and ask, “Khana kha liya?”

They’ll still send you money and say, “Tu padhai pe dhyaan de.”

They’ll still hide their worries from you.

And when your result doesn’t come, sometimes they’ll be the ones consoling you.

“Koi baat nahi beta. Agli baar ho jayega.”

Think about that for a moment.

Maybe they were disappointed too.

Maybe they had also imagined calling someone that day and saying, “Ho gaya iska .”

But they swallowed it because they knew you were already hurting.

That is love.🫂

I want you to give them a different phone call.🧿

I want your hands to shake when you dial their number.

And when they pick up, I want you to have only two words

“Ho gaya.”

Maybe your mother cries.

Maybe your father becomes completely silent for a few seconds.

And maybe that silence will contain every fee he paid without telling you , every time your mother prayed for you… every relative’s question they quietly answered… every failure after which they still looked at you and said,


Earn that moment.

Please, earn it yar pls do it. Do it while you can.

Not because you have to repay your parents. Their love was never a loan.

Earn it because there are some moments in life that money can never buy back. Parent ko kuch aur ni deskte hum yar .

You still have the chance to do it , umr badh jayegi bhai .. 

Mai bahut kuch krna chahta ni krskta , tum krlo pls yr

You still have the chance to let them see you walk into that academy.

don’t keep postponing it.

time is also passing for them.

Study a little harder this time. Stay a little longer when your mind asks you to leave. Fight through those few weeks and months.

And someday, when you finally stand where you always wanted to stand…

turn around.

Look at those two people standing behind you.

And quietly tell yourself

"I have made them happy and proud"♥️

- Anurag

● यथावत केंद्र (06 केंद्र): प्रयागराज, झांसी, लखनऊ (35वीं वाहिनी), डा० शकुन्तला मिश्रा पुर्नवास विश्वविद्यालय (लखनऊ), रायबरेली और अलीगढ़ में परीक्षा पूर्व निर्धारित शेड्यूल (01.10.2026) के अनुसार ही होगी

● संशोधित प्रवेश पत्र (Admit Card): जिन अभ्यर्थियों की परीक्षा 08.10.2026 को तय की गई है, उनके संशोधित प्रवेश-पत्र 30.09.2026 को भर्ती बोर्ड की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर अपलोड कर दिए जाएंगे।

24 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS) ने Ayurveda Day 2026 के अवसर पर लॉन्च की गई पहली Ayush Services Sector Report तैयार की।
The first Ayush Services Sector Report, launched on the occasion of Ayurveda Day 2026, was prepared by the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS).

➼ Asian Development Bank (ADB) ने सितंबर 2026 के आउटलुक में वित्त वर्ष 2026–27 के लिए भारत की GDP वृद्धि दर 7.0% रहने का अनुमान लगाया है।
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) projected India’s GDP growth at 7.0% for FY 2026–27 in its September 2026 outlook.

➼ मीराबाई चानू ने Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 में महिलाओं की 49kg Weightlifting स्पर्धा में रजत पदक जीता।
Mirabai Chanu won the Silver Medal in the women’s 49kg weightlifting event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026.

➼ जय मीणा Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 में Soft Tennis में भारत के पहले एशियाई खेल पदक विजेता बने।
Jay Meena became India’s first-ever Asian Games medalist in Soft Tennis at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026.

➼ राइज़ा ढिल्लों, माहेश्वरी चौहान और परिनाज़ धालीवाल ने 2026 Asian Games की महिला Skeet Team स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक जीता।
Raiza Dhillon, Maheshwari Chauhan and Parinaaz Dhaliwal won the Bronze Medal in the women’s Skeet Team event at the 2026 Asian Games.

➼ भारत की BRICS अध्यक्षता के तहत सितंबर 2026 में BRICS Tax Heads Meeting का आयोजन New Delhi में किया गया।
The BRICS Tax Heads Meeting was organized in New Delhi under India’s BRICS presidency in September 2026.

➼ 11th Ayurveda Day 2026 की थीम “Ayurveda for a Healthier Tomorrow” है।
The theme of the 11th Ayurveda Day 2026 is “Ayurveda for a Healthier Tomorrow.”

➼ ‘Angen’, जिसका निर्देशन Ravi Raj Murmu ने किया है, 72वें National Film Awards में पुरस्कार जीतने वाली पहली Santali language film बनी।
‘Angen’, directed by Ravi Raj Murmu, became the first Santali-language film to win an award at the 72nd National Film Awards.

➼ रणदीप हुड्डा को ‘Swatantrya Veer Savarkar’ के लिए 72वें National Film Awards में Best Debut Film of a Director का पुरस्कार मिला।
Randeep Hooda won the Best Debut Film of a Director award at the 72nd National Film Awards for ‘Swatantrya Veer Savarkar’.

➼ राजकुमार पेरियासामी को ‘Amaran’ के लिए 72वें National Film Awards में Best Direction का पुरस्कार प्रदान किया गया।
Rajkumar Periasamy received the Best Direction award at the 72nd National Film Awards for ‘Amaran’.

➼ ‘Bhangaar’, जिसका निर्देशन Sumira Roy ने किया है, ने 72वें National Film Awards में Best Non-Feature Film का पुरस्कार जीता।
‘Bhangaar’, directed by Sumira Roy, won the Best Non-Feature Film award at the 72nd National Film Awards.

➼ पूर्णिमा देवी बर्मन को Greater Adjutant Stork (Hargila) के संरक्षण के लिए 8वें Businessline Changemaker Awards में Changemaker of the Year पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।
Purnima Devi Barman was honored with the Changemaker of the Year award at the 8th Businessline Changemaker Awards for the conservation of the Greater Adjutant Stork (Hargila).

➼ Border Roads Organisation (BRO) को 8वें Businessline Changemaker Awards में Iconic Changemaker पुरस्कार दिया गया।
The Border Roads Organisation (BRO) was awarded the Iconic Changemaker award at the 8th Businessline Changemaker Awards.

➼ Oxford Economics Global Cities Index 2026 की समग्र रैंकिंग में Delhi शीर्ष रैंक वाला भारतीय शहर है।
According to the Oxford Economics Global Cities Index 2026, Delhi is the top-ranked Indian city in the overall ranking.

➼ World Rhino Day 2026 के अवसर पर भारत सरकार ने एक सींग वाले गैंडों के संरक्षण के लिए Project Rhino (Phase 1: 2026–2031) की घोषणा की।
On World Rhino Day 2026, the Government of India announced Project Rhino (Phase 1: 2026–2031) for the conservation of one-horned rhinos.
